attempts.summary: Installed and configured dnsmasq on node1 as an internal DNS resolver that answers inventory-api.internal with node2's IP (10.100.171.11) and forwards all other queries upstream (8.8.8.8). Configured node2's systemd-resolved (via /etc/systemd/resolved.conf.d/10-internal.conf) to use node1 (10.100.171.10) as DNS server for the ~internal domain while keeping its DHCP-provided resolver for everything else. Verified resolution end-to-end, falsified correctness by stopping dnsmasq on node1 (lookup failed with connection refused) then restored it (lookup succeeded again). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both node1 and node2, proving changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of the resolver and configuration.
